checks.text: With no habits defined, the page shows the text "No habits yet".
Typing "Read" in the field labelled "Habit name" and clicking the button "Add habit" adds a list item containing "Read" and changes the text "No habits yet" to disappear.
After adding the habit "Read", clicking the button "Log today" logs today's date as done for "Read"; the streak display for "Read" shows "Streak: 1".
After logging "Read" for today, clicking the button "Log yesterday" logs yesterday's date as done for "Read"; the streak display for "Read" shows "Streak: 2".
After logging "Read" for today and yesterday, clicking the button "Log today" again does not change the streak; the streak display for "Read" still shows "Streak: 2".
Clicking the button "Delete Read" removes the habit "Read" from the list and the page shows the text "No habits yet".
After adding the habit "Read" and logging it for today, clicking the tab "Heatmap" shows a heatmap grid where the cell for today's date has the data attribute `data-value="1"`.
Reload keeps the habit "Read" and its logged entries; after reloading, the list item containing "Read" is present and the streak display shows "Streak: 1".
